liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jam of Various Themes** (4 reviews): Let It Grow dissolves into Space, Dark Star, and Mind Left Body Jam themes; Jam features MLB, Dark Star, minor-2-chord, and space sections before U.S. Blues [11][13][17][19]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Called the best Sugar Magnolia ever, paired with the best Scarlet Begonias [8]
- **Let It Grow** (1 review): Reviewer highlights the Let It Grow performance and the jam that follows [9]
- **Mind Left Body Jam** (1 review): Jam uses I-IV G major 7 - C major 7 modality; Jerry plays like a tiger [10]

## The recordings

- **gd1974-06-28.149954.mtx.seamons.ht120.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 26 songs; 233 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1974-06-28.139780.sbd.miller.fixed.flac1644**: soundboard; 25 songs; 211 min; rated 4.8/5 by 5 [2]
- **gd74-06-28.set1.sbd.snider.10984.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 12 songs; 68 min; rated 4.5/5 by 14 [7]
- **gd1974-06-28.139780.sbd.patched.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 25 songs; 211 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer wishes for leftover songs to complement Dick's Picks, thanking the GD organization [18]
- Jerry Moore's taping stopped during U.S. Blues due to security pressure [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1974-06-28.149954.mtx.seamons.ht120.flac16**: source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut > Soundtrack Pro > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging) [1]. Also: Jerry Moore recorded the show; Charlie Miller transferred the SBD; Rob Berger transferred AUD [1]
- **gd1974-06-28.139780.sbd.miller.fixed.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Master Reel > Dat (48k) [2]. Also: This is a fixed version of the soundboard recording for the show [2]
- **gd74-06-28.set1.sbd.snider.10984.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [7]. Also: Reviewer originally had a decent AUD tape with dropouts, now prefers Dick's copy [12]
- **gd1974-06-28.139780.sbd.patched.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Master Reel > Dat (48k) [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1974-06-28 Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1974-06-28-backstage-pass/) [23]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Boston Garden - June 28, 1974](https://www.dead.net/show/june-28-1974) [24]
